explanation_full:
The feature analysis reveals that VFA, Butyrate, and Acetate consistently rank highly across multiple feature selection metrics. According to the GRA ranking, VFA (0.7931) and Butyrate (0.7902) are the top two features, followed closely by Acetate (0.7772). Feature importance analysis confirms this trend, with VSS having the highest importance (0.5052), followed by Acetate (0.12) and Butyrate (0.097). Correlation analysis highlights strong relationships, notably between Butyrate and VFA (0.9601) and Acetate and VFA (0.9428). 

Regarding model performance, the incremental feature selection process identified the optimal feature set for KNN. The best performance was achieved with 9 features (R2=0.8301, MSE=0.0119), using the subset: VFA -> Butyrate -> Acetate -> VSS -> Propionate -> Ethanol -> COD-O -> pH -> ORP_Low. This set significantly outperforms the performance achieved with fewer or more features, suggesting that these nine variables capture the most predictive information for the KNN model.
